ACT VI OF 2004
ACT VI OF 2004
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001 (XVIII of 2001)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 13th August, 2004]
No. PAB/:Legis: V (21)/2004,
dated 13-8-2004.--The Balochistan Local Government Bill, 2004 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 13th August, 2004 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Local Government
(Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on 13th day of April, 2003.

Amendment of section 150 of Ordinance, XVIII of 2001

passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 13th August, 2004 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment of section 150 of
Ordinance, XVIII of 2001.--In the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance,
2001, in subsection (4) of section 150 for the word "three" the word
"four" shall be substituted.
